clipboard_write.desc: Write text to the system clipboard (macOS/Linux/Windows).

params.text: Text to copy to the clipboard.

clipboard_read.desc: Read the current text from the system clipboard (macOS/Linux/Windows). Output is capped by default so a large clipboard cannot flood AI context.

params.max_bytes: Maximum clipboard bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Set 0 for unlimited.

http_request.desc: Make an HTTP request and return status code, response body (JSON is auto-pretty-printed), and timing. Response body is capped by default to avoid flooding AI context. Cross-platform — prefer this over running curl/wget via run_command. For binary files or large downloads, use download_file instead.

params.method: HTTP method: GET (default), POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS.
params.headers: Request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer token"}.
params.body: Request body string. Pass a JSON string for JSON APIs.
params.timeout_seconds: Request timeout in seconds. Default: 30. Max: 300.
params.include_response_headers: Include response headers in output. Default: false.
params.max_response_bytes: Maximum response body bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Max: 10485760 (10 MB). Set 0 for unlimited.

list_processes.desc: List running processes with PID, name, CPU/memory usage, and full command. Cross-platform — prefer this over ps/tasklist via run_command. CPU and MEM units differ by OS: on POSIX they are percentages from ps; on Windows, CPU is total CPU time in seconds and MEM is working-set in MB — column headers reflect this automatically.

params.filter: Case-insensitive substring to filter by process name or command. Omit to list all.
params.limit: Maximum processes to return. Default: 50. Set 0 for unlimited.
params.command_width: Maximum command column width before truncation. Default: 80, max: 500.

get_system_info.desc: Return a system resource snapshot: CPU model, core count, memory usage, and disk usage.

download_file.desc: Download a file from a URL and save it to a local path. Uses streaming — no memory buffering — so it handles large files without OOM. Creates parent directories automatically. Prefer this over http_request + write_file for binary files or large downloads.

params.path: Local file path to save to. Parent directories created automatically.
params.headers: Optional request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer token"}.
params.timeout_seconds: Request timeout in seconds. Default: 300. Max: 600.
params.overwrite: Overwrite if file already exists. Default: false.
